sections.text_helper: Section 10.6.6 "RAMCFG AHBSRAMx interrupt status register (RAMCFG_AHBSRAMxISR)" in chapter 10 (SRAM configuration controller (RAMCFG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 297.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x308 + 0x80 * (x - 1), (x = 1 to 2)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reset on any system reset.
Bits 31:9 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 8 SRAMBUSY: SRAM busy with erase operation
Depending on the SRAM, the erase operation can be performed due to software request,
system reset if the option is not disabled by software and tamper detection (seeTable33).
0: No erase operation ongoing
1: Erase operation ongoing
Bits 7:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
